name: popover
title: Popover
description: Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Popover: a speech bubble (3px line, round corners) with a tail toward the trigger, popping in. Adds PopoverBubble, a static twin for previews.
docs: Import from "@/components/ui/manga/popover". It wraps your own components/ui/popover, so Radix and Base UI both work.

meta.tagline: A speech bubble pointing at its trigger.
meta.usage:
import { Popover, PopoverContent, PopoverTitle, PopoverTrigger } from "@/components/ui/manga/popover"

<Popover>
  <PopoverTrigger>Details</PopoverTrigger>
  <PopoverContent><PopoverTitle>Vol. 3</PopoverTitle>18 pages.</PopoverContent>
</Popover>
